g.text: One cluster, two machines, explicit workload boundaries
03 / DEPLOYMENT CPU server + GPU worker share K3s. Docker jobs and host services remain on the CPU VM.
CPU VM / 8 vCPU · 64 GiB RAM / K3s server
One control/data host. Worker replicas do not establish control-plane HA.
K3s / individual workload resources on the CPU node
Docker / long-lived containers and bounded jobs
Selected recorded resources, not a complete cluster inventory. Each workload has its own label. Movement shows route direction, not live readiness.
